newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call may harden after repo auction: I-Sec.
newsitem.headline: Indian call may harden after repo auction: I-Sec.

text.p: Indian call money rates could harden in the next few days following the large subscription to the repo auction on Tuesday, ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said in a report.
"The repo auction garnered 41.0 billion rupees at a cut-off yield of 3.95 percent, down from 4.0 percent earlier," it said.
"The large subscription at the repo should see overnight rates hardening and a downward reaction in gilt prices is likely over the next few days," it said.
I-Sec said prices of government securities eased marginally on Tuesday despite call rates being low at 4.5-5.0 percent.
